summary_en: Nippon Yusen K.K. to launch cash tender offer for all shares of NS United Kaiun (currently 18.55% owned). Board endorses offer and recommends shareholder acceptance. Tender price and offer size not yet disclosed. Tender planned Nov.–Dec. 2026, subject to domestic and foreign antitrust clearance (Japan, Australia, China, Brazil). Following completion, NS United Kaiun shares to be delisted and made non-public. Board committed to reaffirm recommendation upon tender commencement.
title_en: Notice of Board Endorsement and Shareholder Recommendation Regarding Planned Commencement of Cash Tender Offer for Company Shares by Nippon Yusen K.K. (Related Party)
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, NS United Kaiun held a board meeting and resolved to express support for, and recommend shareholder acceptance of, a planned cash tender offer by Nippon Yusen K.K. (the "offeror") for all ordinary shares of NS United Kaiun. The offeror currently owns 4,324,725 shares (18.35% direct) plus 45,800 shares indirectly through its wholly owned subsidiary Utsumi Hikisen K.K., totaling 4,370,525 shares (18.55% of issued stock excluding treasury). The tender offer is expected to launch in late November to late December 2026, following completion of antitrust filings and approvals in Japan, Australia, China, and Brazil. The precise timing will be announced once regulatory timetables are confirmed. Tender offer price and share count are not disclosed in this document. Following the tender, NS United Kaiun shares are expected to be delisted and made non-public. The board committed to consult its special committee upon commencement to confirm the committee's 31 July 2026 opinion remains unchanged, and to reaffirm its endorsement at the time the offer launches.
